ITEM 1 | Small round grains, tan to golden-brown with a matte, slightly glossy surface, sitting in a loose heap with some darker reddish-brown tint and a few bits of dark sauce coating; grains are individually distinct and spill slightly toward the lower left, covering roughly 30% of the plate's visible food area with a height of about 1 cm | 110

ITEM 2 | Piece of fish fillet with dark, crisp, slightly charred skin on top and a pale pinkish-orange flesh edge showing at the side, about 4 cm by 3 cm and 1.5 cm thick, sitting to the right of the grains with a smooth, moist-looking surface | 90

ITEM 3 | Halved or quartered green vegetables (brussels sprouts style) with blackened, charred outer leaves and bright green inner cut faces, clustered in the lower center of the plate, each piece about 2 to 3 cm across, with glossy, slightly oily sheen and softened texture | 60

ITEM 4 | Thin dark reddish-purple sliver, a small fragment lying at the upper left edge of the grain heap, about 1 cm long and under 0.5 cm thick, with a moist, slightly glossy surface | 3
